train_PPOTrainer: run the PPOTrainer train method to start training a navigation agent with PPO algorithm
save_checkpoint_PPOTrainer: save a PPOTrainer checkpoint to disk with the specified file name and extra state
load_checkpoint_PPOTrainer: load a PPOTrainer checkpoint from a file path and return the checkpoint dict
eval_checkpoint_PPOTrainer: evaluate a single PPOTrainer checkpoint using the Evaluator and log results to TensorBoard
get_device: get the PyTorch device from a config returning CUDA if available or CPU as fallback
